referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A cinematic full-bleed photograph opens the page with a centered light title, a short line, and an outlined action. A white intro section follows with a centered statement and a short paragraph. Feature chapters use coordinated image-and-copy rows, then a dark geometric band and an elements showcase close the page. The type is a thin humanist sans. Warm sunset photography, white surfaces, and deep purple-gray bands create a calm, image-led rhythm.
